description: This file defines the StaticDispatcherServlet class, which extends the Spring DispatcherServlet to handle static content within the OpenMRS web application. It manages initialization, application context refresh, and shutdown procedures for the static content dispatcher.

classes.name: StaticDispatcherServlet
classes.description: A custom Spring DispatcherServlet for managing static content in OpenMRS, with methods to initialize, refresh application context, and stop the servlet.

methods.name: initFrameworkServlet
methods.description: Initializes the servlet, setting the context class loader and registering the servlet instance for later use.

methods.name: refreshApplicationContext
methods.description: Refreshes the application context, typically after module changes, to reload static content configuration.

methods.name: stopAndCloseApplicationContext
methods.description: Stops and closes the application context, used during shutdown.
